verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
By the inkstand and by the pen and by that which they write,
Thou art not, by the grace of thy Lord, a madman.
And for thee, most surely, there is an unending reward.
And thou dost surely possess high moral excellences.
And thou wilt soon see and they too will see
Which of you is afflicted with madness.

verses.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّکَ ہُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنۡ ضَلَّ عَنۡ سَبِیۡلِہٖ ۪ وَہُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِالۡمُہۡتَدِیۡنَ ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: Surely, thy Lord knows best those who go astray from His way, and He knows best those who follow guidance.
So comply not with the wishes of those who reject the truth.
They wish that thou shouldst be pliant so that they may also be pliant.
w: so that they may also be pliant

verses.en: And yield not to any mean swearer,
Backbiter, one who goes about slandering,
Forbidder of good, transgressor, sinful,
Ill-mannered and, in addition to that, of doubtful birth.
This is because he possesses riches and children.

verses.ar: اِذَا تُتۡلٰی عَلَیۡہِ اٰیٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِیۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِیۡنَ ﴿۱۶﴾
verses.en: When Our Signs are recited unto him, he says, ‘Stories of the ancients!’
We will brand him on the snout.

verses.ar: اِنَّا بَلَوۡنٰہُمۡ کَمَا بَلَوۡنَاۤ اَصۡحٰبَ الۡجَنَّۃِ ۚ اِذۡ اَقۡسَمُوۡا لَیَصۡرِمُنَّہَا مُصۡبِحِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۱۸﴾
verses.en: We will surely try them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would certainly pluck all its fruit in the morning,
w: that they would certainly pluck all its fruit

verses.en: And they made no exception and did not say, ‘If God please.’
w: they made exception and did not say, if God please’

verses.ar: فَطَافَ عَلَیۡہَا طَآئِفٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّکَ وَہُمۡ نَآئِمُوۡنَ ﴿۲۰﴾
verses.en: Then a visitation from thy Lord visited it while they were asleep;
And the morning found it like a garden cut down overnight.
So they called to one another at the break of dawn,
w: so they called to one another

verses.ar: اَنِ اغۡدُوۡا عَلٰی حَرۡثِکُمۡ اِنۡ کُنۡتُمۡ صٰرِمِیۡنَ ﴿۲۳﴾
verses.en: [✲]Saying, ‘Go forth early in the morning to your field, if you would gather the fruit.’
w: go forth early in the morning

verses.en: And they set out, talking to one another in low tones,
w: talking to one another in low tones

verses.ar: اَنۡ لَّا یَدۡخُلَنَّہَا الۡیَوۡمَ عَلَیۡکُمۡ مِّسۡکِیۡنٌ ﴿ۙ۲۵﴾
verses.en: [✲]Saying, ‘Let no poor man today enter it against you.’
[✲]And they went forth early in the morning, determined to achieve their purpose.
w: and they went forth early in the morning

verses.en: But when they saw it, they said, ‘Surely, we have lost our way!
‘Nay, we have been deprived of everything.’

verses.ar: قَالَ اَوۡسَطُہُمۡ اَلَمۡ اَقُلۡ لَّکُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُوۡنَ ﴿۲۹﴾
verses.en: The best among them said, “Did I not say to you, ‘Why do you not glorify God?’ ”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَ رَبِّنَاۤ اِنَّا کُنَّا ظٰلِمِیۡنَ ﴿۳۰﴾
verses.en: Now they said, ‘Glory be to our Lord. Surely, we have been wrongdoers.’
Then some of them turned to the others, reproaching one another.
[✲]They said, ‘Woe to us! We were indeed rebellious against God.

verses.ar: عَسٰی رَبُّنَاۤ اَنۡ یُّبۡدِلَنَا خَیۡرًا مِّنۡہَاۤ اِنَّاۤ اِلٰی رَبِّنَا رٰغِبُوۡنَ ﴿۳۳﴾
verses.en: ‘Maybe our Lord will give us instead a better garden than this; we do humbly entreat our Lord.’

verses.ar: کَذٰلِکَ الۡعَذَابُ ؕ وَلَعَذَابُ الۡاٰخِرَۃِ اَکۡبَرُ ۘ لَوۡ کَانُوۡا یَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ﴿٪۳۴﴾
verses.en: Such is the punishment of this world. And surely the punishment of the Hereafter is greater. Did they but know!

verses.ar: اِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّہِمۡ جَنّٰتِ النَّعِیۡمِ ﴿۳۵﴾
verses.en: For the righteous, indeed, there are Gardens of Bliss with their Lord.
Shall We then treat those who submit to Us as We treat the guilty?
What is the matter with you? How judge ye!
Have you a Book wherein you read,
That you shall surely have in it whatever you choose?

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَکُمۡ اَیۡمَانٌ عَلَیۡنَا بَالِغَۃٌ اِلٰی یَوۡمِ الۡقِیٰمَۃِ ۙ اِنَّ لَکُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡکُمُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۴۰﴾
verses.en: Or have you any covenant binding on Us till the Day of Resurrection that you shall surely have all that you order?
Ask them which of them will vouch for that.

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَہُمۡ شُرَکَآءُ ۚۛ فَلۡیَاۡتُوۡا بِشُرَکَآئِہِمۡ اِنۡ کَانُوۡا صٰدِقِیۡنَ ﴿۴۲﴾
verses.en: Or have they any ‘partners’ of God? Let them, then, produce those ‘partners’ of theirs, if they speak the truth.

verses.ar: یَوۡمَ یُکۡشَفُ عَنۡ سَاقٍ وَّیُدۡعَوۡنَ اِلَی السُّجُوۡدِ فَلَا یَسۡتَطِیۡعُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۴۳﴾
verses.en: On the day when the truth shall be laid bare and they will be called upon to prostrate themselves, they will not be able to do so;
w: and they will be called upon
they will be able to do so

verses.ar: خَاشِعَۃً اَبۡصَارُہُمۡ تَرۡہَقُہُمۡ ذِلَّۃٌ ؕ وَقَدۡ کَانُوۡا یُدۡعَوۡنَ اِلَی السُّجُوۡدِ وَہُمۡ سٰلِمُوۡنَ ﴿۴۴﴾
verses.en: Their eyes will be cast down, and humiliation will cover them; and they were indeed called upon to prostrate themselves when they were safe and sound, but they obeyed not.
w: were safe and sound, but they obeyed not

verses.ar: فَذَرۡنِیۡ وَمَنۡ یُّکَذِّبُ بِہٰذَا الۡحَدِیۡثِ ؕ سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُہُمۡ مِّنۡ حَیۡثُ لَا یَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۴۵﴾
verses.en: So leave Me alone with those who reject this word of Ours. We shall draw them near to destruction step by step from whence they know not.
w: We shall draw them near to destruction step by step

verses.en: And I give them respite; for My plan is strong.

verses.ar: اَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُہُمۡ اَجۡرًا فَہُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّغۡرَمٍ مُّثۡقَلُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۴۷﴾
verses.en: Dost thou ask a reward of them that they are as if being weighed down with a heavy tax?
Is the unseen with them so that they write it down?

verses.ar: فَاصۡبِرۡ لِحُکۡمِ رَبِّکَ وَلَا تَکُنۡ کَصَاحِبِ الۡحُوۡتِ ۘ اِذۡ نَادٰی وَہُوَ مَکۡظُوۡمٌ ﴿ؕ۴۹﴾
verses.en: So be thou steadfast in carrying out the command of thy Lord, and be not like the Man of the Fish when he called to his Lord and he was full of grief.

verses.ar: لَوۡلَاۤ اَنۡ تَدٰرَکَہٗ نِعۡمَۃٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّہٖ لَنُبِذَ بِالۡعَرَآءِ وَہُوَ مَذۡمُوۡمٌ ﴿۵۰﴾
verses.en: Had not a favour from his Lord reached him, he would have surely been cast upon a bare tract of land, while he would have been blamed by his people.
w: he would have surely been cast
upon a bare tract of land
would have been blamed by his people

verses.en: But his Lord chose him and made him one of the righteous.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ یَّکَادُ الَّذِیۡنَ کَفَرُوۡا لَیُزۡلِقُوۡنَکَ بِاَبۡصَارِہِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّکۡرَ وَیَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اِنَّہٗ لَمَجۡنُوۡنٌ ﴿ۘ۵۲﴾
verses.en: And those who disbelieve would fain dislodge thee from thy God-given station with their angry looks when they hear the Reminder; and they say, ‘He is certainly mad.’
[✲]Nay, it is naught but a source of honour for all the worlds.
